connectivity_tips.tip: The UK offers reliable 4G and 5G coverage throughout London and most surrounding areas. Popular providers include EE, Vodafone UK, O2 and Three UK.
connectivity_tips._source_file: England and Scotland/Bhushan- London - All Inclusive Guide_v3.docx

connectivity_tips.tip: eSIM is recommended for short trips as it can be activated before departure. Popular providers include Airalo, Holafly and Nomad. Approximate cost: ₹1,000–₹3,000 depending on data package and validity.
connectivity_tips._source_file: England and Scotland/Bhushan- London - All Inclusive Guide_v3.docx

connectivity_tips.tip: Physical SIM cards can be purchased upon arrival at Heathrow Airport, Vodafone Stores, EE Stores, O2 Stores, and convenience stores & supermarkets. Approximate cost: ₹1,000–₹2,500. Passport required; valid visa may be requested.
connectivity_tips._source_file: England and Scotland/Bhushan- London - All Inclusive Guide_v3.docx

connectivity_tips.tip: A 10–20 GB data plan is usually sufficient for a one-week trip covering navigation, WhatsApp, social media and travel apps.
connectivity_tips._source_file: England and Scotland/Bhushan- London - All Inclusive Guide_v3.docx

health_tips.tip: The United Kingdom does not require any special vaccinations for travellers arriving from India. However, ensure routine immunisations are up to date before international travel.
health_tips._source_file: England and Scotland/Bhushan- London - All Inclusive Guide_v3.docx

health_tips.tip: Recommended vaccinations: Routine vaccinations (MMR, Tetanus, Diphtheria, Polio), Hepatitis A, Typhoid, and Annual Flu Vaccine (optional, depending on season and personal preference).
health_tips._source_file: England and Scotland/Bhushan- London - All Inclusive Guide_v3.docx
